name: Carlo Ancelotti
scopeNote: Manager profile of Carlo Ancelotti across six counted spells: AC Milan (2001 to 2009: Champions League 2002-03 and 2006-07, Serie A 2003-04), Chelsea (2009 to 2011: Premier League and FA Cup 2009-10), Paris Saint-Germain (2011 to 2013: Ligue 1 2012-13), Real Madrid (2013 to 2015: Champions League 2013-14), Bayern Munich (2016 to 2017: Bundesliga 2016-17) and Real Madrid again (2021 to 2025: two La Liga and Champions League doubles). The Wikipedia infobox gives years only, so the spell dates are partial and the profile period is partial too. Excluded: Parma 1996-97, Juventus 1999-2001, Napoli 2018-19, Everton 2019-21 and the Brazil national team from 2025 (outside this profile's era).
